observation.limitations: Read-only strict profile-local aggregate review, daily UTC buckets rather than exact event times. Producer 0.4.2-alpha.2; not current loaded-version proof. No Session/turn IDs, sequence, lower-category pool fit or classifier diagnostic retained. completeHistory=false, restarts=1, dropped/expired/saturated=0 in this snapshot. Cannot recover failure causes, transition matrix, execution, quality, billing or savings; no raw export uploaded.

previousReview: Issues #332/#333 prior allocation review and post-delivery review #334; diagnostic-only follow-up #398.
findings: 63 decisions: 44 local/unknown, 4 semantic/unknown and 15 semantic/complex, all powerful target/selection. Sol selected 57 and Astra 6; 47 marked previous-model retention, not a transition matrix. Local/unknown may include disabled/unavailable/timeout/failed/invalid-result fallbacks. Semantic/unknown may include omitted-context conservatism. Persisted aggregates discarded those diagnostics, so historical causes cannot be established.
decision: Retain classification, category routing, positive weights, continuity, eight-second deadline, context safety and existing consent. Add only fixed content-free assessment outcomes to daily candidate/no-fit strata and their existing table. Keep legacy absent reasons explicitly unrecorded. Do not force downgrades, increase the timeout or infer classifier/network failure from unknown demand.
validation: Regression-first collector tests reproduced diagnostic cohort collapse and merging fresh rows with legacy unrecorded rows. 70 focused assessment/classifier/routing/collector/UI tests, source/test types and four public gateway/storage fixture tests including reopen passed. The complete 130-file low-concurrency suite passed 2724 tests with two expected skips; the default-concurrency full gate hit an existing 5000ms allocation stress-test timeout. No timeout or assertion weakened. Tooling/package and required Windows/Linux delivery gates are recorded separately in the implementation PR; this document does not claim live activation.

followUp.owner: Maintainer or Agent assigned to post-delivery review issue #334
followUp.trigger: Review assessment outcomes after 200 new decisions with recorded reasons, or before the next assessment policy change. Retain the prior allocation trigger of 200 opportunities per model across 20 Sessions only if independently evidenced; aggregates cannot count Sessions.
followUp.metric: Selected plus no-fit counts by fixed assessment outcome, producer version, source and demand; explicit unrecorded/truncated/dropped/expired/saturated/restart coverage. Keep candidate opportunities and actual versus expected selections separate from task counts.
followUp.action: Use local sanitized aggregates to fix an evidenced dominant assessment failure or retain the conservative fallback; unknown or insufficient evidence defers tuning. No automatic upload, transition reconstruction, quality inference or credit inference. Track implementation in #398 and the open post-delivery review in #334.
